<addendum>
# Repository: IDX Financial Report Pipeline (`financial-report-llm`)

This project downloads financial reports from the Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX),
converts them to markdown (docling), parses XLSX statements into DuckDB, and runs a
multi-stage LLM analysis pipeline that writes equity-research notes into the
`analysis/` Obsidian vault.

## Layout

- `scripts/report_pipeline/` — download → identify → collect → convert + XLSX parser
- `scripts/analysis_pipeline/` — 6-stage LLM analysis pipeline (needs `OPENCODE_API_KEY`)
- `scripts/notes_rag/rag.py` — hybrid BM25 + vector search over `analysis/`
- `idx_data/pipeline.duckdb` — pipeline state + financial data (source of truth)
- `idx_data/notes_rag.duckdb` — vault search index
- `raw/` identified PDFs · `results/` converted markdown · `analysis/` Obsidian vault

## Environment

- Python dependencies live in `.venv`; run scripts as `.venv/bin/python <script>` or
  `uv run <script>`.
- `duckdb` CLI is installed. Open the database read-only:
  `duckdb -readonly idx_data/pipeline.duckdb`.
- Model IDs and timeouts live in `config.yaml`; secrets (`OPENCODE_API_KEY`,
  `EXA_API_KEY`) in `.env` (gitignored — never commit or print).
- `.pi/settings.json` declares the project's pinned pi packages
  (`npm:pi-exa-search@0.1.3`, `npm:pi-web-access@0.41.0`) plus a delta entry
  that disables the global `npm:pi-web-search` extensions in this project.
  Project packages load after project trust (`--approve` for pipeline runs).
- Stage 3b (research) runs on pi in two steps: the planner
  (`research_plan.py`) with the read-only idx-tools and **no** web tools, then
  the search agent with `exa_search` / `fetch_content`. Stage 4 (writer) also
  runs on pi with the read-only idx-tools `duckdb_query`, `notes_search`,
  `notes_fetch` plus `read`.
- `.pi/xdg/pi/web-search.json` configures `pi-web-access` for the Stage 3b
  research runner (fed via `XDG_CONFIG_HOME`); `.agents/skills/` holds dev-time
  Agent Skills (e.g. `build-with-exa`), not loaded by research runs.

## Conventions

- Quote financial values with their units, source table, and period.
  `financial_ratios` values are in billions of IDR (except `eps`);
  `xlsx_statements` values are raw IDR.
- Period formats: `financial_ratios.period` is `"YYYY-MM-DD"`; `xlsx_statements.period`
  and `pipeline_jobs.period` are lowercase `audit | tw1 | tw2 | tw3`.
- Prefer the notes vault (`notes_search`) and DuckDB (`duckdb_query`) over guessing.
  Cite the note path or the table you queried.
- Never commit runtime artifacts: `.env`, `idx_data/analysis/`, `.venv`, `idx_data/*.duckdb`.

## Project skills (`.pi/skills/`)

- `idx-financial-db` — query company ratios, balance sheet, income statement, cash flow
- `vault-search` — search the `analysis/` equity-research notes
- `report-review` — review/write an IDX equity analysis
- `data-pipelines` — run/inspect the report and analysis pipelines

</addendum>

toolsAdded.name: duckdb_query
toolsAdded.description: Run a read-only SQL query against the IDX pipeline database (idx_data/pipeline.duckdb). Use for Indonesian stock financials, ratios, valuation multiples, peer comparisons, and XBRL statement line items. Key tables: financial_ratios (code, name, sector, period, assets, liabilities, equity, sales, ebt, profit, eps, book_value, per, pbv, der, roa, roe, npm; values in billions of IDR except eps; period='YYYY-MM-DD'), xlsx_statements (ticker, year, period, sheet_code, row_number, label_id, label_en, value_current, value_prior; raw IDR; period lowercase audit|tw1|tw2|tw3), company_profiles, pipeline_jobs, downloaded_files, xlsx_meta, converted_documents. The database is opened read-only, so writes will fail by design.

sql.description: A single read-only SQL statement, e.g. SELECT code, roe FROM financial_ratios WHERE code='ADRO' ORDER BY period DESC LIMIT 5;

toolsAdded.name: notes_search
toolsAdded.description: Hybrid semantic + keyword (BM25) search over the analysis/ Obsidian vault — equity research notes on IDX stocks (analyses by ticker/quarter, commodity deep-dives, earnings forecasts, geopolitics, saved articles; English and Indonesian). Returns ranked excerpts with file path, section breadcrumb, an obsidian:// URI, and a chunk id. Use it FIRST for any question about companies, commodities, forecasts, or prior research before falling back to general knowledge. Read a full result with notes_fetch.

query.description: Natural-language query (EN or ID), tickers, quarters, or numbers, e.g. 'ammonia price sensitivity' or 'ELSA Q1 2026 margin'

ticker.description: Restrict to chunks mentioning an IDX ticker, e.g. ESSA

toolsAdded.name: notes_fetch
toolsAdded.description: Fetch the full text of a single vault chunk by id (from a notes_search result). Prefer this over reading the whole markdown file when you only need one section.

id.description: Chunk id from a notes_search hit (the JSON `id` field)

Note Q2 standalone vs YTD: tw2 is likely Jan-Jun cumulative. Compute standalone Q2 = tw2 - tw1 = 42,512,568 - 21,108,433 = 21,404,135. tw1 NII = 24,592,248 - 3,483,815 = 21,108,433.

So Q2 (three months) NII ≈ 21.40 (in the same units, million).

Is BBCA even a bank in financial_ratios? no rows — mention.

BBCA does not appear in `financial_ratios` (no rows returned), so the figures below come from `xlsx_statements` (sheet 4322000, BBCA, year 2026). Values are as stored in the table (millions of IDR).

| Period | Interest income | Interest expenses | Net interest income |
|---|---|---|---|
| tw1 2026 | 24,592,248 | 3,483,815 | 21,108,433 |
| tw2 2026 (YTD) | 49,765,390 | 7,252,822 | **42,512,568** |

Arithmetic:
- tw1 NII = 24,592,248 − 3,483,815 = 21,108,433
- tw2 YTD NII = 49,765,390 − 7,252,822 = 42,512,568
- Q2 standalone = 42,512,568 − 21,108,433 = 21,404,135

Sheets 4312000 (consolidated?) show the same rows as NULL. So: NII was ~Rp42.51tn for H1 2026 (YTD), of which ~Rp21.40tn in Q2 alone. Note BBCA's tw2 filing has not been verified for consolidation scope beyond the sheet above.

content.text:
BBCA does not appear in `financial_ratios` (no rows returned), so the figures below come from `xlsx_statements` (sheet 4322000, BBCA, year 2026). Values are as stored in the table (millions of IDR).

| Period | Interest income | Interest expenses | Net interest income |
|---|---|---|---|
| tw1 2026 | 24,592,248 | 3,483,815 | 21,108,433 |
| tw2 2026 (YTD) | 49,765,390 | 7,252,822 | **42,512,568** |

Arithmetic:
- tw1 NII = 24,592,248 − 3,483,815 = 21,108,433
- tw2 YTD NII = 49,765,390 − 7,252,822 = 42,512,568
- Q2 standalone = 42,512,568 − 21,108,433 = 21,404,135

Sheets 4312000 (consolidated?) show the same rows as NULL. So: NII was ~Rp42.51tn for H1 2026 (YTD), of which ~Rp21.40tn in Q2 alone. Note BBCA's tw2 filing has not been verified for consolidation scope beyond the sheet above.
